strategy.name: Dual SMA Trend Following (MA20 cross-up + filter MA150)
strategy.entry: Close[s] > SMA20[s] AND Close[s-1] <= SMA20[s-1] AND Close[s] > SMA150[s]
strategy.execution: sinyal dari candle tertutup s, eksekusi pada harga bid/ask tick berikutnya (backtest: open bar s+1)
